title: Control Reinforcement Learning: Interpretable Token-Level Steering of LLMs via Sparse Autoencoder Features
abstract: arXiv:2602.10437v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language model activations into interpretable features, but existing methods reveal only which features activate, not which change model outputs when amplified. We introduce Control Reinforcement Learning (CRL), which trains a policy to select SAE features for steering at each token, producing interpretable intervention logs: the learned policy identifies features that change model outputs when amplified. Adaptive Feature Masking encourages diverse feature discovery while preserving singlefeature interpretability. The framework yields new analysis capabilities: branch point tracking locates tokens where feature choice determines output correctness; critic trajectory analysis separates policy limitations from value estimation errors; layer-wise comparison reveals syntactic features in early layers and semantic features in later layers. On Gemma 2 2B across MMLU, BBQ, GSM8K, HarmBench, and XST

translated_title: 控制强化学习：通过稀疏自编码器特征实现大语言模型可解释的词元级引导
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）可以将语言模型的激活分解为可解释的特征，但现有方法只能揭示哪些特征被激活，而不能识别哪些特征在被放大时会改变模型输出。我们提出了控制强化学习（Control Reinforcement Learning, CRL），该方法训练一个策略在每个词元处选择用于引导的SAE特征，从而生成可解释的干预日志：学习到的策略能够识别出在被放大时会改变模型输出的特征。自适应特征掩码机制在保持单特征可解释性的同时，鼓励发现多样化的特征。该框架还带来了新的分析能力：分支点追踪可以定位特征选择决定输出正确性的词元；评论家轨迹分析能够将策略局限与价值估计误差区分开来；逐层比较揭示了早期层中的句法特征和后期层中的语义特征。在Gemma 2 2B模型上，该方法在MMLU、BBQ、GSM8K、HarmBench和XST等基准上进行了验证。
tldr: 提出控制强化学习（CRL）框架，通过训练策略在每个词元处选择稀疏自编码器特征来引导大语言模型，从而自动识别出真正能改变模型输出的可解释特征。
